export TZ=America/Los_Angeles; date "+now %H:%M %Z"
echo "=== all workflows, newest first ==="
invoker-cli query workflows 2>/dev/null | head -8
echo
echo "=== any task anywhere still running or pending? ==="
invoker-cli query tasks --status running --output json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import json,sys
try: d=json.load(sys.stdin)
except: print('  (none)'); raise SystemExit
ts=d if isinstance(d,list) else d.get('tasks',d)
print(f'  running: {len(ts)}')
for t in ts: print(f\"    {t.get('id')}\")"
invoker-cli query tasks --status pending --output json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "
import json,sys
try: d=json.load(sys.stdin)
except: print('  (none)'); raise SystemExit
ts=d if isinstance(d,list) else d.get('tasks',d)
print(f'  pending: {len(ts)}')
for t in ts[:12]: print(f\"    {t.get('id')}\")"
